title: 85 South: Ghetto Legends
overview: DC Young Fly, Karlous Miller and Chico Bean bring their famous podcast to the stage to create a unique comedy special where nothing and no one is safe from their jokes.

title: Chris Rock: Tamborine
overview: Chris Rock takes the stage for his first comedy special in 10 years, filled with searing observations on fatherhood, infidelity and American politics.

title: Deon Cole: Charleen's Boy
overview: In an electric stand-up special, Deon Cole ponders romance, racist hotel showers, post-coital bedtime prayers and why he loves women of a certain age.

title: Deon Cole: Ok, Mister
overview: From the telltale signs of aging to bedroom mishaps and dating deal-breakers, Deon Cole spins comedy gold in this playfully candid special.

title: Leslie Jones: Time Machine
overview: From trying to seduce Prince to battling sleep apnea, Leslie Jones traces her evolution as an adult in a joyfully raw and outrageous stand-up special.

title: Michael Che Matters
overview: "SNL" star Michael Che takes on hot-button topics like inequality, homophobia and gentrification in this stand-up set filmed live in Brooklyn.

title: Michelle Buteau: Welcome to Buteaupia
overview: Scene-stealing queen Michelle Buteau dazzles with real talk on relationships, parenthood, cultural differences and the government workers who adore her.

title: Mo Gilligan: There's Mo to Life
overview: Mo Gilligan breaks down his days as a broke teenager, working in retail, relationship dynamics, annoying talk show producers and more in this special.

title: Nicole Byer: BBW (Big Beautiful Weirdo)
overview: Nicole takes the stage at the Gramercy Theatre for a HOT new set, discussing everything from how she basically is a vegan (she's just doing her part), what she's looking for in a man, and just how crazy this past year-and-a-half has been.

title: Trevor Noah: Afraid of the Dark
overview: The 'Daily Show' host ponders the perils of naming countries, how traffic lights turn New Yorkers invincible and why you shouldn't drink in Scotland.

title: Trevor Noah: I Wish You Would
overview: Emmy-winning comedian Trevor Noah talks learning German, speaking ill of the dead, judging people in horror movies and ordering Indian food in Scotland.

title: Chris Tucker: Live
overview: Comedian Chris Tucker performs live.

title: Dave Chappelle: Sticks & Stones
overview: Dave Chappelle takes on gun culture, the opioid crisis and the tidal wave of celebrity scandals in this defiant stand-up special.

title: Mike Epps: Delusional
overview: Follows comedian Mike Epps as he discusses how a little delusion and a lot of hustle made him a star.

title: Sommore: Queen Chandelier
overview: This Queen of Comedy shines as she takes the stage to sound off on her suspicion of free stuff, social media prayer requests, fake lashes and ugly shoes.

title: Wanda Sykes: I'm an Entertainer
overview: The comedy icon sounds off on parenting with her French wife, the perils of public bathrooms and why she's tired of going high when others go low.

title: Kevin Hart: Zero F**ks Given
overview: Kevin Hart serves up laughs and brick oven pizza from the comfort of his home, and dishes on male group chats, sex after 40 and life with COVID-19.

title: Michelle Buteau: A Buteau-ful Mind at Radio City Music Hall
overview: Michelle Buteau talks going viral, raising twins, and the lows of getting high in this herstory-making special.

title: Nate Bargatze: The Greatest Average American
overview: Nate Bargatze touches on Zoom comedy shows, losing his phone, hotel breakfast fails, animal caddies, new math and much more in this special.

title: Cristela Alonzo: Lower Classy
overview: The irrepressible Alonzo skewers Latino stereotypes, pricey luxuries and her mother's tough-love parenting in a night of sly and infectious comedy.

title: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You
overview: Jeff Arcuri's rapid-fire wit is nonstop as he balances outrageous jokes with heartfelt reflections on making his wife laugh during her cancer journey.

title: The Roast of Tom Brady
overview: Offensive lines. Full-contact comedy. Kevin Hart hosts this all-star roast of NFL legend Tom Brady.

title: Jim Gaffigan: King Baby
overview: The greatly anticipated follow up to the platinum selling Beyond the Pale. In this Austin performance that capped off the 2008 sold-out stand up tour, Gaffigan does not let the audience catch their breath. This all-new show proves no other comedian working today can romanticize laziness and over-indulgence like Jim Gaffigan.

title: Ali Wong: Hard Knock Wife
overview: Pregnant again, Ali Wong returns to Netflix in her second original stand-up comedy special and gets real on why having kids is not all it's cracked up to be.

title: Jamie Foxx: What Had Happened Was...
overview: Oscar- and Golden Globe-winning actor. Grammy-winning singer. Beloved comedian. Jamie Foxx returns to the stage to set the record straight.

title: Brian Regan: On the Rocks
overview: Brian Regan tackles the big issues weighing on him, including aging, time, obsessive behavior, backpacks on airplanes, ungrateful horses and raisins.

title: Jen Kirkman: Just Keep Livin'?
overview: Incisive comic Jen Kirkman gets real about women's bodies, the value of alone time and an Italian private tour guide who may have been a ghost.

title: Daniel Sloss: Live Shows
overview: Comedian Daniel Sloss is ready to find the funny in some very dark topics, from the deeply personal to the truly irreverent.

title: Deaw Special: Super Soft Power
overview: Iconic Thai comedian Udom Taephanich recounts his misadventures and sharp observations from uncomfortable encounters to the absurdities of daily life.

title: Chelsea Handler: The Feeling
overview: From ruining Thanksgiving to a wild summer fling, Chelsea Handler recounts coming of age, unexpected encounters and that time she met Bill Cosby.

title: Dave Chappelle: The Dreamer
overview: From his onstage tackle to the slap heard round the world, Dave Chappelle lets loose in this freewheeling and unfiltered stand-up comedy special.

title: Ali Wong: Baby Cobra
overview: Ali Wong might be seven-months pregnant, but there’s not a fetus in the world that can stop this acerbic and savage train of comedy from delivering a masterful hour of stand-up.

title: Adam Sandler: 100% Fresh
overview: Adam Sandler takes his comical musical musings back out on the road, from comedy clubs to concert halls to one very unsuspecting subway station.

title: That’s My Time with David Letterman
overview: David Letterman invites some of the hottest up-and-coming stand-up stars to perform a set and sit down for a chat.

title: Panayotis Pascot: Almost
overview: Those who still see him as an innocent teen TV correspondent are in for a surprise: French comic Panayotis Pascot is all grown up and ready to get real.

title: Jonas Brothers Family Roast
overview: Kevin, Joe and Nick face down quick wits and deep cuts in this comedy special featuring Pete Davidson, John Legend and more. Hosted by Kenan Thompson.

title: The Honeymoon Stand Up Special
overview: Impending parenthood does funny things to Natasha Leggero and Moshe Kasher, who dissect family, relationships and more in a trio of stand-up specials.

title: Jim Jefferies: Freedumb
overview: Returning for a second Netflix comedy special, Jim Jefferies unleashes his famously ferocious black humor to a packed house in Nashville, Tennessee.

title: Bo Burnham: The Inside Outtakes
overview: Exactly one year after the release of the one man show, "Bo Burnham: Inside" (made in one room, by one person, throughout the pandemic,) comes a series of unseen outtakes, deleted scenes, alternative versions of songs, and new songs unused from the special.

title: Bill Burr: I'm Sorry You Feel That Way
overview: Fresh, unflinching and devastatingly honest, Bill Burr lets loose in this feature length comedy special. Burr shares his essential tips for surviving the zombie apocalypse, exposes how rom-coms ruin great sex and explains how too many childhood hugs may be the ultimate downfall of man.

title: Anthony Jeselnik: Fire in the Maternity Ward
overview: Forging his own comedic boundaries, Anthony Jeselnik revels in getting away with saying things others can't in this stand-up special shot in New York.

title: Ricky Gervais: Armageddon
overview: Ricky Gervais dishes out controversial takes on political correctness and oversensitivity in a taboo-busting comedy special about the end of humanity.

title: Gabriel "Fluffy" Iglesias: One Show Fits All
overview: Gabriel "Fluffy" Iglesias discusses his teenage son and encounters with Snoop Dogg, Chris Rock and Vicente Fernández in this stand-up special for 2019.

title: Franco Escamilla: Ladies' man
overview: Franco Escamilla takes the stage with tales of teenage romance gone wrong, featuring painfully long kisses and rockstar cameos with surprising outcomes.

title: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav
overview: In this unruly set, Stavros Halkias imagines becoming a "dirtbag" uncle, roasts the health care system and warns of the risks of living your best life.
